parameters.description: How much research Parallel does before answering. 'Low' suits simple facts (about 5-10 seconds), 'Medium' questions that need a few lookups (about 15-20 seconds), and 'High' questions that need broad research and synthesis (up to a minute, and the most expensive).

parameters.description: Optional guidance on how to answer, for example, 'Answer in two sentences' or 'Give amounts in euros'.
